needs.proposedSignature: { kind: 'fortification', keywords?: Keyword[], power?: number, toughness?: number, fortifyCost: ManaCost, attachFilter?: Filter } as a StaticEffect variant, a Ref 'fortified' alongside 'equipped' / 'enchanted', a covers[].by kind 'fortify' with the shape /^fortify (\{.+\})$/, and a filter field on the tapped trigger event
needs.semantics: Fortify is equip for lands: the Fortification attaches to a land you control at sorcery speed and stays on the battlefield if the land leaves. equipment is creature-only and its granted keywords ride on a creature's P/T; there is no Ref naming the fortified land; and { on: 'tapped' } carries only self: boolean, so "whenever fortified land becomes tapped" cannot be restricted to the attached permanent. Filter.attachedToSource already exists for the dies/ltb case and is the right field for the trigger filter.
needs.clause: Fortified land has indestructible. / Whenever fortified land becomes tapped, ... / Fortify {3}
